responseMessageContents.text:
In the Rork UI, the undo lives in the **chat sidebar on the left** — hover over any of your past messages and a small **circular arrow / "restore" icon** appears next to it (sometimes inside a "⋯" menu). Click it to roll the project back to right before that message.

If you're on mobile or just don't see it, the simplest path is to tell me here: say *"revert the mountain icons change"* and I'll do it from my side.
